session_summary: Stages 1 and 2 are on main (0d34a17, a1abcff) and Stage 3 (579c8ae); all three still need real-machine proof. Stage 4 built at the user's request while 1-3 wait: fanout/engine.py (typing and send fallbacks, ReplyWatcher, per-account delay, timeouts with screenshot, CAPTCHA/limit stop, cancel), fanout/results.py (Markdown, Copy All, .md/.json export, auto-save, searchable prompt history), fanout/runview.py (side-by-side results screen), js reply/stop helpers, worker 'send_all'. PROVEN here in real headless Chrome against LOCAL fake streaming chat sites through the Worker thread: 3 prompts run at once (overlapping timestamps), long streamed answer with a long pause captured complete, one account timing out leaves the others fine, CAPTCHA pauses only that account, results saved as account_N.md plus run.json, cancel presses Stop and leaves windows open, no orphan browser processes after cancel or shutdown. One real-run bug found and fixed: with nothing mapped and an empty chat, the reply reader returned the page's own script text (innerText of a hidden script is its code); it now skips script/style parts and looks for the reply area again after sending (regression test added, shown failing without the fix). pytest: 100 passed (non-UI). NOT proven: the Tk results screen and its buttons (no Tkinter here), real chat sites, real Brave, Windows/macOS.
